mapper.insert: INSERT INTO render_tasks (id, script_id, status, video_task_ids, output_path, error_message, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{scriptId}, #{status}, #{videoTaskIds}, #{outputPath}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM render_tasks WHERE script_id = #{scriptId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
